config.authority: single-process HTTP batch service, serialized immutable ledger snapshots; no cache
config.gate: search top 5 or 20 in shared scoped index; batch HTTP current-policy check; keep first 5 allowed; fail closed on HTTP errors or old epoch

queries: 160 source-support vectors reused; three ownership assignments, not independent queries
security_denominator: 480 case-seed units per representation/regime/phase/arm; repetitions reserved for timing
policy_contract: check against current ledger snapshot, not time of client receipt; no distributed-consistency claim
